topic: Sensor data analysis and signal strength
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the effectiveness of changing antenna locations to improve sensor data. It was noted that while moving antennas improved signal strength (e.g., at Diepsloot, sessions with signals weaker than 87 disappeared after 2023-11-29), this improvement did not guarantee an increase in overall traffic or session volume.

Concerns were raised regarding whether the enhanced signal quality translated into increased user activity or if the low traffic levels persisted despite better sensor readings.
